summary: Improve livestock care records, welfare checks, feeding, and sustainability planning. Explore the five-day sustainable animal husbandry course.
lede: Animal husbandry training helps livestock practitioners organise routine care while considering animal welfare and farm resources. For livestock farmers, farm supervisors, animal-care workers, and extension practitioners, it provides practical ways to check daily husbandry and plan feasible improvements. You practise welfare inspections, feed and water checks, health and grazing records, and farm sustainability reviews using TAPE and guided GLEAM-i assessment examples.
audienceIntro: This course suits people responsible for livestock care or for advising on the day-to-day routines that affect animal health, welfare, feed use, and farm sustainability. It is designed for practitioners with experience in livestock production who want to make their husbandry checks and records more consistent.
prerequisites: Prior experience with routine livestock care, farm supervision, animal-care work, or livestock extension is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with the records or husbandry routines used in your work where available.
